description: This file contains the server-side code for the 'TheoryExam.aspx' page in the Online Examination System. It handles loading multiple quiz questions from the database, managing session states, navigation, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam.aspx page, managing quiz question loading, user navigation, answer submission, and timer control.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization, loads questions from the database based on session variables, and sets the timer for the exam.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on the course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Saves user answers into the database, updates course and admin queues, and records the course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles timeout scenario.
